第二天，王建新早早醒了。

躺在空间里的床上，他看了看手腕上的和平牌手表——早上六点多一点。空间里的光线永远是那么亮堂堂的，看不出早晚。但身体有自己的节奏，睡够了自然就醒了，不困不累，精神头足得很。

他躺着没动，脑子里在想一件事。

空间里的时间和外面不一样，他一直知道。但具体差多少，到现在也没摸清楚。有时候觉得在里面待了很久，出来一看没过多少时间；有时候觉得没待多大会儿，出来天都黑了。

“得弄清楚。”王建新自言自语。

他起了床，意念一动，出了空间，来到土坯房里。从空间里拿出那块火箭牌手表，看了一眼时间——六点二十分，跟他手上的和平牌一样，两块表走得都挺准。

他把火箭表放在土坯房的桌上，然后又进了空间。

进了空间，他先不干别的，就坐在床边等着。时不时看看手腕上的表，心里默默数着时间。

等了感觉有一阵子了，他看了看表——在空间里待了大概四十五分钟。

身影一闪，出了空间。

土坯房里，火箭表静静地躺在桌上。他拿起来一看——正好过去半个小时。

王建新心里算了一下。外面半小时，空间里四十五分钟，比例是一比一点五。也就是说，外面过去一天，空间里过去一天半。

“虽然时差不咋大，但总比没有强。”王建新把火箭表放回桌上。

一天能多出半天时间，一年下来就多出好几个月。种地、修炼、鼓捣东西，都能多出不少工夫来。他心里挺满意，把这事记下了，以后安排时间就好办了。

弄清楚时间，王建新开始干正事。

今天他想做点奶制品。

苏和教过他怎么做奶皮、奶豆腐、奶疙瘩、黄油。在苏和家住的那阵子，他跟着学了好几回。

他先来到奶牛跟前。

空间里有两头奶牛，是从蒙古国那边收来的。在空间里养了几天，吃了鲜嫩的青草，已经看着圆乎一些了。

王建新蹲下来，先跟奶牛打了个招呼。摸了摸牛头，顺着毛捋了捋，嘴里嘟囔着：“乖啊，给点奶，回头给你吃好的。”

奶牛甩了甩尾巴，没理他，但也没躲。

王建新拿了两个盆，蹲在一头奶牛旁边，开始挤奶。手指一上一下，白色的奶水滋滋地流进盆里。他手法还算熟练，在苏和家练出来的，虽然比不上老牧民那么利索，但也不慢了。

不一会，两个盆就满了。

他又找了两个盆，继续挤。两头奶牛挨个挤了一遍，挤了四盆牛奶，白花花的，上面浮着一层薄薄的奶皮。

王建新看了看表，挤奶用了大概四十分钟。

他端着奶盆出了空间，在土坯房外面支起大锅，点上火。

先做奶皮。

他把牛奶倒进锅里，小火慢煮。煮到锅面上结了一层厚厚的奶皮，用筷子挑起来，挂在通风的地方晾着。一层奶皮挑完了，再煮，再挑。一锅奶能挑出三四层奶皮来，一层比一层薄，但都香得很。

奶皮挑完了，剩下的奶做奶豆腐。把奶继续煮，煮到浓缩了，加一点酸奶引子，慢慢搅。奶慢慢凝成一团一团的，用纱布过滤掉乳清，把凝块压进模子里，压实了，晾干。做出来的奶豆腐白嫩嫩的，切成一块一块的，能放好长时间。

The next day, Wang Jianxin woke up early.

Lying on the bed in the space, he looked at the Peace watch on his wrist - it was a little after six in the morning.The light in the space is always so bright, and you can't tell whether it's morning or evening.But the body has its own rhythm. After sleeping enough, it will naturally wake up. I will not be sleepy or tired, and I will feel very refreshed.

He lay still, thinking about one thing.

Time in space is different from outside, he has always known.But the exact difference is still not clear until now.Sometimes I feel that I have been in there for a long time, and when I come out, it seems that not much time has passed; sometimes I feel that I have not been there for very long, and it is already dark when I come out.

"We have to figure it out." Wang Jianxin said to himself.

He got up, and with a thought, he left the space and came to the adobe house.He took out the Rocket watch from the space and took a look at the time - six-twenty. Just like the peace sign in his hand, both watches were accurate.

He placed the rocket watch on the table in the adobe room and entered space again.

After entering the space, he did nothing else but sat by the bed and waited.From time to time, I look at the watch on my wrist and count the time silently in my mind.

After waiting for what felt like a while, he looked at his watch - he had been in the space for about forty-five minutes.

The figure flashed and left the space.

In the adobe house, the rocket watch lay quietly on the table.He picked it up and looked - exactly half an hour had passed.

Wang Jianxin did some calculations in his mind.Half an hour outside, forty-five minutes in the space, the ratio is one to one point five.In other words, one day has passed outside, and one and a half days have passed in space.

"Although the time difference is not that big, it is better than nothing." Wang Jianxin put the rocket watch back on the table.

An extra half day in a day can add up to several extra months in a year.Farming, cultivating, and tinkering with things can all give you a lot more time.He was quite satisfied and wrote it down so that it would be easier to arrange time in the future.

After figuring out the time, Wang Jianxin got down to business.

Today he wanted to make some dairy products.

Su He taught him how to make milk skin, milk tofu, milk lumps and butter.While staying at Su He's house, he learned from it several times.

He came to the cow first.

There are two cows in the space, which were collected from Mongolia.After raising it in the space for a few days and eating fresh green grass, it already looks a little rounder.

Wang Jianxin squatted down and said hello to the cow first.He touched the cow's head, smoothed it along with its fur, and muttered: "Be good, give me some milk, and I'll feed you some good food later."

The cow swung its tail and ignored him, but she didn't hide either.

Wang Jianxin took two basins, squatted next to a cow, and started milking.With his fingers moving up and down, white milk flowed sizzlingly into the basin.His technique is quite proficient and he was trained at Su He's house. Although he is not as agile as the old herdsman, he is not slow either.

After a while, the two basins were full.

He found two more basins and continued to squeeze.The two cows were milked one after another, milking four pots of milk. The milk was white and had a thin layer of milk skin floating on it.

Wang Jianxin looked at his watch and saw that milking took about forty minutes.

He took the milk basin out of the space, set up a large pot outside the adobe house, and lit a fire.

Make the milk skin first.

He poured the milk into the pot and brought it to a simmer.Cook until a thick layer of milk skin forms on the surface of the pot. Pick it up with chopsticks and hang it in a ventilated place to dry.After picking out one layer of milk skin, cook it again and pick it again.A pot of milk can pick out three or four layers of milk skin. Each layer is thinner than the other, but they are all very fragrant.

After picking out the milk skin, the remaining milk is used to make milk tofu.Continue to cook the milk until it is concentrated, add a little yogurt starter and stir slowly.The milk slowly curdles into balls. Use gauze to filter out the whey, press the curds into the mold, compact them, and let them dry.The milk tofu is white and tender, cut into pieces, and can be stored for a long time.
